test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Many students who have taken online courses feel that ______.

options.text: online courses are only for working people
nothing can replace face-to-face traditional learning
traditional classrooms have better content and teachers
online experience is equal, if not better than the traditional

solution:
The correct answer is **"online experience is equal, if not better than traditional".**
